profiles.name: Evie
profiles.guidance: Draft concise friendly responses. Never claim a payment or order is confirmed without verification. Human approval required.

quick_replies.label: Hello
quick_replies.text: Hey you 💕 What did you have in mind?

quick_replies.label: Busy
quick_replies.text: Hey! I’m tied up for a bit, but I’ll get back to you soon.

quick_replies.label: Custom
quick_replies.text: I can go over the available options. What did you have in mind?

profiles.name: Customer Service
profiles.guidance: Give helpful service answers. Do not invent pricing, availability, purchases or confirmations.

quick_replies.label: Pricing
quick_replies.text: I can send you the available options and pricing.

quick_replies.label: Follow-up
quick_replies.text: Checking back in! Do you still need help with this?

profiles.name: Personal
profiles.guidance: Keep personal conversation separate from customer follow-ups.

quick_replies.label: Later
quick_replies.text: I’ll message you back when I’m free 💕

automations.name: Pricing inquiry
automations.reply: I can send you the menu and help you pick an option.

automations.name: Custom request
automations.reply: Tell me a little more about what you're looking for and I can explain the options.

automations.name: Payment question
automations.reply: I’ll check the payment status and confirm once I’ve verified it.

automations.name: Availability inquiry
automations.reply: Let me check my availability and get back to you!
